flags.message: The docket shows 'Response Requested' on 2026-10-06 after both respondents waived, but the frozen context carries band 'baseline' under sal-v4 (relists, CVSG, circuit only) and response_requested is null (an interim-docket field). The call for a response is the dominant grant signal on this docket and the band does not encode it, so this cell's number sits well above the baseline reached-rate anchor it is scored against by design, not by error. A cert-stage call-for-response cut in the statpack, or a band feature for it, would make the anchor comparable.
